messages:
alex: pushed a follow-up commit that addresses the review comments (split out the eviction loop, added a small unit test, and updated changelog). CI is running but wanted to flag this for a quick look when you have a few mins. commit: `a2b45f9`

mira: great — thanks for tackling the loop cleanup. will take a look this afternoon. did you run a quick perf check after the change?

alex: yes, ran the microbench on my laptop and a small staging run. ~2% lower p50 for short sequences. gist with results: https://gist.github.com/redwood/evict-bench (short summary in the changelog)

ci-bot: Build started for commit a2b45f9 — running unit tests, lint, and integration smoke. (CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/12345)

sam: skimmed the diff — one nit: the var name `thr` is a little vague, could we expand to `evictThreshold`? otherwise looks good.

alex: good catch, thanks. renamed to `evictThreshold` and pushed as a2b45f9 -> a2b45f9.1 (force-pushed). git command I ran: ```git checkout fix/evict-loop && git commit --amend -m "rename thr -> evictThreshold and add unit" && git push --force-with-lease```

jordan: quick Q — if CI passes, are we okay to merge before today's deploy window (3pm PT)? trying to keep the release small.

alex: i'd prefer to run a staging smoke at ~2:30pm PT and then merge if green. change is small but hits cache eviction so want a quick sanity.

mira: sounds reasonable. @sam can you re-check the rename change once CI finishes?

sam: will re-check, should be quick. if CI green and smoke test passes I'll approve.

ci-bot: All checks passed for commit a2b45f9. unit tests: 142/142, lint: ok, integration: ok.

alex: ran staging smoke at 14:28 PT — heatmap and traces look fine, no error spikes. staging link: https://staging.redwood.internal/smoke/evict-2026-03-17

mira: did a quick code pass on the final pushed commit. the rename and test look good. approving now. :rocket:

sam: re-reviewed, LGTM. adding approval. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks! merging and squashing now (`git merge --squash` + annotated message). will watch prod after the 3pm PT deploy window.

jordan: thanks all — small, well-scoped change. flagging for release notes (ops) and will include in the next changelog snippet.

alex: noted — I'll add a one-liner to the release notes and monitor alerts. if anything odd, I'll open a follow-up but shouldn't be needed. :+1:
